title: Nominations Open for Exterior Design Week 2025 Recognition
summary: Enter to be recognized for phenomenal exterior siding work and a photoshoot valued at or up to $1,500 during James Hardie’s Exterior Design Week 2025
body_markdown:
Trade professionals have an opportunity to get recognized for their great work during James Hardie’s Exterior Design Week 2025, happening on our social channels and website May 25-31.


## **Nominations are open from Wednesday, April 2-Friday, April 11.**


Nominate yourself or someone else in one of five categories:


- **Best Exterior Design featuring Hardie** **®** **Products:** Any project exemplifying exterior design and featuring Hardie® products are eligible.
- **Best Exterior Design featuring James Hardie’s 2025 Color of the Year – Evening Blue:** Any project featuring Evening Blue from the Statement Collection® is eligible.
- **Best Exterior Design featuring a Complete Exterior™ by James Hardie (including Hardie** ***®*** **Siding, Trim, and Soffit):** Must feature a Complete Exterior™ by James Hardie to be eligible.
- **Best Exterior Design featuring Hardie** ***®*** **Artisan** ***®*** **Products or Hardie® Architectural Panel:** Must feature Hardie® Artisan® products or Hardie® Architectural Panel to be eligible.
- **Best Exterior Design Transformation featuring Hardie** **®** **Products:** Any re-side project featuring Hardie® products is eligible! Must include before and after photos.
- **Best Multi-Family Exterior Design featuring Hardie® Products:** Must be a multi-family project to be eligible.


*Please refer to the full rules below for more information.*


Traditional home with Evening Blue Hardie® lap siding with Select Cedarmill texture.


### **Enter by April 11! Here’s how:**


- Email submissions to[\[email protected\]](https://www.jameshardie.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#97f5e5f6f9f3d7fdf6faf2e4fff6e5f3fef2b9f4f8fa)
- Include the nominee’s first/last name, company, email, and phone number
- Specify the submission’s categories
- Attach relevant project photos
- Provide specific products and colors featured
- Confirm homeowner consent to photography of their home, we will follow-up with release forms
- All submissions must be made by 11:59PM CST on April 11, 2025.


Leading up to and during Exterior Design Week 2025, James Hardie will feature various professionals and their projects on our channels — celebrating the great work you do and showcasing what’s possible when design and durability come together with Hardie® products.


We’re excited to see your submissions! Reach out to[\[email protected\]](https://www.jameshardie.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#d7b5a5b6b9b397bdb6bab2a4bfb6a5b3beb2f9b4b8ba) with questions.


---


#### Rules for Entry


**Enter for a chance to be featured on James Hardie Channels for Exterior Design Week and/or receive Snappr photos valued at or up to $250 from James Hardie.**


James Hardie Building Products Inc. (“James Hardie”) is giving away a chance to be featured on James Hardie Channels for Exterior Design Week and/or a Snappr Photography Photoshoot (“Photoshoot”), with a retail value up to $250 dollars.


For an opportunity to be selected to be featured and/or for the Photoshoot, you must email your submissions to[\[email protected\]](https://www.jameshardie.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#bad8c8dbd4defad0dbd7dfc9d2dbc8ded3df94d9d5d7) . Be sure to include your first/last name and the name of your company (if you are nominating someone else, please include this information as well as their email address and phone number). In your email, tell us which category (or categories) you’re submitting a nomination for. Include any relevant photos of the project and tell us which products/colors are featured and let us know if the homeowner(s) consent to photography.


Submissions will be accepted starting April 2nd at 12:00AM CST-April 11th at 11:59PM CST. Submissions received after April 11th at 11:59PM will not be considered. James Hardie will coordinate with the winner in order to send the Photoshoot via e-mail within 7 days of the drawing. Possibility of being chosen for Photoshoot depends on the number of eligible submissions, aesthetic quality of the submission (inclusive of landscaping), and conformance with the eligible categories.


James Hardie reserves the right to offer a Photoshoot to more than one entrant.


To be eligible for the Photoshoot, the submitted and selected entrant must have been a completed project featuring Hardie® products. Incomplete or in-process projects are not eligible.


Selection, receipt and completion of a Photoshoot is subject to and contingent upon you as recipient meeting all of the eligibility requirements, conditions and limitations under these terms and conditions. If you fail to satisfy any of these requirements or conditions in James Hardie’s sole judgment, you will not be eligible for the Photoshoot. James Hardie reserves the right in its sole absolute discretion and for any reason to rescind the Photoshoot and select an alternate recipient. Subject to all applicable laws and regulations.


The terms contained herein are subject to and governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to conflict of law principles. As a condition of consideration of your submission, you agree that any and all disputes which cannot be resolved between the parties and causes of action arising out of or connected with this giveaway, shall be resolved individually, without resort to any form of class action, exclusively before a court located in Illinois having jurisdiction. Further, in any such dispute, under no circumstances will you be permitted to obtain awards for, and hereby waive all rights to claim punitive, incidental, or consequential damages. Submissions are subject to the privacy policy found on our website. Read the privacy policy here:[https://www.jameshardie.com/about-us/privacy-policy-information-collected](https://www.jameshardie.com/about-us/privacy-policy-information-collected)
